summary: Three overdue hikers (a woman in her 60s, a woman in her 40s, and an infant) en route from the West Maroon Portal to Crested Butte with no overnight gear. MRA deployed 7 members; before MRA reached the summit the trio was located uninjured by a good samaritan at the Schofield Pass trailhead and transported to Crested Butte.
location: West Maroon Pass trail (West Maroon Portal toward Crested Butte); subjects found at Schofield Pass trailhead
